description: This file contains static functions for printing test results in different protocols (CLAP and TAP) for the clar testing framework. It includes functions for initializing, shutting down, reporting errors, and indicating test and suite progress, with support for different verbosity levels and output formats.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_init
methods.description: Prints initialization message for CLAP protocol, indicating loaded test suites.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints shutdown message for CLAP protocol and calls clar_report_all().

methods.name: clar_print_indented
methods.description: Prints a string with indentation, handling multi-line strings.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_error
methods.description: Prints detailed failure report for a test error in CLAP protocol.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_ontest
methods.description: Reports individual test result in CLAP protocol, with verbosity control.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onsuite
methods.description: Indicates start of a test suite in CLAP protocol.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onabort
methods.description: Outputs an abort message in CLAP protocol.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_init
methods.description: Prints TAP protocol version header.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints TAP plan line indicating total test count.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_error
methods.description: Placeholder for printing TAP errors (not implemented).

methods.name: print_escaped
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for TAP output.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_ontest
methods.description: Reports individual test result in TAP protocol, with detailed failure info if verbose.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onsuite
methods.description: Indicates start of a test suite in TAP protocol.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onabort
methods.description: Outputs a bailout message in TAP protocol.

methods.name: clar_print_init
methods.description: Dispatches initialization message based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_shutdown
methods.description: Dispatches shutdown message based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_error
methods.description: Dispatches error report based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_ontest
methods.description: Dispatches individual test result based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onsuite
methods.description: Dispatches suite start message based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabortv
methods.description: Dispatches abort message with variable arguments based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabort
methods.description: Variadic wrapper for clar_print_onabortv.
